### OOS_1: [OOS] Rebase conflict waterfall can misread launcher failure
- **Description**: python/agents.py make_conflict_launch_fn parses LAUNCHER_EXIT only from FD-3 stdout. When a CI launcher tier exits non-zero before emitting LAUNCHER_EXIT, the waterfall misclassifies a failed tier as success.
- **Filed URL**: https://github.com/character-ai/larch/issues/4086
- **Reviewer**: cursor-specialist-correctness-output.txt
- **Vote tally**: accepted
- **Phase**: review
